name: Air China Cargo Co., Ltd.
summary: Air China Cargo Co., Ltd. provides air logistics services in China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Air Cargo Services, Air Cargo Terminal Services, and Integrated Logistics Solutions. It offers freight solutions, including freshCAre, a solution for perishable goods; coolCAre, a solution for temperature-controlled goods; secureCAre, a solution for valuable and vulnerable goods; expressCAre, a solution for urgent shipments; pharmaCAre, a solution for temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products; gallopCAre, a solution for horses; tailorCAre, a solution for special shipments; and dgCAre, a solution for dangerous goods.
